environment.identity_reason: attach exact compiler command and source hashes in evidence/report wrapper; binary cannot infer them

layout.interpretation: active ABI observations, not universal offsets or guaranteed reorder savings; internal gaps align members, tail padding permits aligned array stride. Padding contents are never read; explicit field encoding is needed for portable wire formats. Object alignment, allocation alignment and cache-line spacing are different properties.

arena.policy: non-owning, single-threaded; no individual free; reset does not run destructors and invalidates old handles

fixed_pool.policy: bounded fixed-size individual reclamation, not general malloc; invalid-release checks O(capacity); caller owns object lifetimes

monotonic_hardcap.block_free_snapshot_null_reason: no successful explicit block/free pair in this route

pool.block_free_snapshot_null_reason: no successful explicit block/free pair in this route

policies.pool_chunk_counts: observed, not fixed; metadata may allocate upstream
policies.release: destroy containers and objects before collective release; clear alone is insufficient
policies.counter_limit: counts explicit requests only; no host allocator internals or per-call heap ledger

experiments.workload: bulk lifetime: allocate all, observe all live payloads, destroy objects, free where supported, reset/release

measurement.separation: fresh resource per phase/trial; setup and bounded warmup separate; fill/checksum outside allocation timer; object lifetime separate; teardown includes resource and backing-buffer destruction
measurement.dispatch: common noinline allocation/deallocation dispatch and externally observed full payload/pointer table
measurement.instrumentation: PMR frontend/upstream counting and fixed-pool checked-free overhead are included, not subtracted; custom raw APIs are not PMR-wrapped
measurement.interpretation: no speedup requirement; differing reclamation mechanics and fixed-pool O(capacity) checked frees are included
measurement.null_reason: unsupported timer/metric or opaque PMR/host internals; not measured zeros

metric_definitions.requested_live_payload: sum trace bytes while all blocks live; object phase includes reserved bytes beyond object size
metric_definitions.backing_capacity: caller byte-buffer size, excluding typed slot metadata
metric_definitions.resource_acquired: counted upstream requested bytes, not host hidden size or RSS
metric_definitions.consumed: arena cursor; live fixed-slot strides; host client-visible payload only; PMR unknown
metric_definitions.alignment_slack: arena cumulative gaps or fixed-pool leading alignment gap; PMR/host unknown
metric_definitions.slot_rounding: live fixed-slot strides minus requested payload; non-slot host/arena zero, PMR unknown
metric_definitions.metadata: custom control object sizeof plus fixed-pool reserved typed metadata; excludes common benchmark wrappers/tables; PMR/host unknown
metric_definitions.retained_not_live_after_deallocate: caller byte-buffer capacity plus upstream current bytes when client live payload is zero; includes unused capacity, excludes separately listed typed metadata
metric_definitions.retained_dead_payload_after_deallocate: known unreclaimed workload payload for arena/monotonic, zero after immediate custom-pool/host frees; standard pool reuse/retention opaque

unsupported: fixed-slot requests over 64 bytes or alignment over configured 16
general variable-size individually reclaimed arena/fixed-pool equivalence

fragmentation.kind: deterministic free-interval model, not libc heap
fragmentation.interpretation: external fragmentation is separated holes; adjacent-hole coalescing is explicit. Slot rounding is internal loss, free slots are not automatically external fragmentation. Arena/monotonic dead allocations are temporal retention until reset/release.
